title: fix(mcp): the objectstack://objects resources serve labels in the locale the object tools speak
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_

Fixes #34995

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：stdio 下的 MCP 资源 `objectstack://objects` 与 `objectstack://objects/{name}` 现在和 `list_objects` / `describe_object` 工具一样，按工作区默认语言返回对象名、字段名、说明和选项名。
- 为什么改：之前资源返回作者原文，工具返回译文，AI 读同一个对象可能拿到两种语言的标签（卡上的完成判据：资源和工具对同一对象返回相同标签）。
- 风险与回滚：只改展示文本，不改名字、字段集合和权限；无权读取的字段照旧不出现。回滚即撤销本 PR，资源回到原文。
- 先看：`packages/mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.ts` 的 `servedLocaleObjectView`（工具与资源共用的唯一翻译入口）；`packages/mcp/src/plugin.ts` 中交给资源的视图套上这层；测试文件 `stdio-data-bridge.object-locale-34872.test.ts` 末尾的 `[#34995]` 三条用例。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/stdio-data-bridge.object-locale-34872.test.ts`，预期 8/8 通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `stdio-data-bridge.ts`: the #34872 translation (`inServedLocale` over `translateMetaList`, with `defaultLocaleSources`) moves out of `createStdioDataBridge` to module scope, unchanged, and is wrapped as `servedLocaleObjectView(view, { i18n, protocol })`: an `McpObjectView` whose `listObjects` / `getObject` answer the wrapped view's objects in the transport's locale, and whose declared-object read hands on the untranslated declaration (only `readonly` is read off it). `list_objects` and `describe_object` now read through this wrapper; the dataset path calls the same module-scope `defaultLocaleSources`. No second translation routine.
- `plugin.ts`: the view handed to the object resources (`setRuntimeObjectView`, the call site right before `bridgeResources`) is wrapped in `servedLocaleObjectView` over the same served view (`callerObjectView` under a stdio principal), with the same `i18n` service and `protocol` reads. The served view is what is translated, never the declaration, so a masked field stays absent (ADR-0106 D3/D5).
- `mcp-server-runtime.ts`: doc comment only. `buildObjectListResource` / `buildObjectSchemaResource` translate nothing themselves; they serve labels as the view serves them.
- `servedLocaleObjectView` is not exported from the package entry (`index.ts`); no published surface changes.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/mcp` patch.

## Why

The object tools were localized in #34872 (PR #34922); the two resources still served authored text, so a resource read and a tool call for one object could name it in two languages.

## Tests

New `[#34995]` block in `packages/mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.object-locale-34872.test.ts`, booting the real `MCPServerPlugin` and reading over an in-memory MCP client:

- zh-CN workspace default: the schema resource serves the bundle's object label, description, field labels and descriptions, and option labels; the list resource serves the translated object label; the schema resource equals `describe_object`'s answer byte-for-byte, and the list resource's labels equal `list_objects`'s (the card's done-when).
- A field the principal cannot read stays absent from the translated schema resource, and neither its name nor its authored or translated text appears in the raw text; `fieldCount` counts only served fields.
- `en` default with no entry, and no i18n service on the host: authored labels on the resources and the tools alike.

## Acceptance notes

- HTTP door: out of scope by construction. Resources are registered only on the long-lived stdio server (`bridgeResources`, `this.mcpServer.registerResource`, `mcp-server-runtime.ts`); `handleHttpRequest` builds a per-request server that registers tools and prompts and no resources, so there is no HTTP resource to localize.
- File surface: the claim names `mcp-server-runtime.ts` "and where the resources are registered". The resources' view is handed over and `bridgeResources` is called in `plugin.ts` (`setRuntimeObjectView` at the resource registration call site), so the wrap lands there. It is the only place the resources' view is set.
- The engine double in the new test block declares `find` and `getSchema` only (the verbs the stdio principal resolution reads); a first draft carried an unused `update` that `check:engine-double-contract` flagged.
